rows.label: qst630503_msg0001
rows.name: Ahaha! That was pretty fun!

rows.label: qst630503_msg0002
rows.name: I'm exhausted...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0003
rows.name: Ten'i, how was it?

rows.label: qst630503_msg0004
rows.name: As usual.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0005
rows.name: But...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0006
rows.name: Looks like it isn't over yet.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0007
rows.name: Now this is interesting...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0008
rows.name:
One was hard enough, and now there are
three...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0009
rows.name: No problem...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0010
rows.name: If I use my full power...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0011
rows.name: Ghh... My power...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0012
rows.name: No, Ten'i-san!

rows.label: qst630503_msg0013
rows.name:
...It was starting to run wild, but it
settled down?

rows.label: qst630503_msg0014
rows.name: Raiko's power...?

rows.label: qst630503_msg0015
rows.name:
I just thought I had to stop
Ten'i-san, but...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0016
rows.name:
It seems easier to fight when Raiko
controls it.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0017
rows.name: I see...!

rows.label: qst630503_msg0018
rows.name:
Driver, if it's all right, Ten'i-san
and I will take one.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0019
rows.name:
We'll be fine if we work together with
the other Blades! Leave it to us!

rows.label: qst630503_msg0020
rows.name:
If Raiko and Ten'i's group take one,
maybe I'll take one too.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0021
rows.name:
Then the Driver only has to deal with
the remaining one, right?

rows.label: qst630503_msg0022
rows.name:
But if you want to fight all three at
once, I won't stop you.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0023
rows.name:
I think that sounds interesting too,
so you decide how to handle it,
Driver.

rows.label: qst630503_msg0024
rows.name:
Let's go back to Rijite Port for now
and decide what to do...

rows.label: qst630503_msg0101
rows.name: Are you all right?
